title: Stylised forest props: cartoon pine, bush, mushrooms, flowers
summary: Hand-painted cartoon forest set from GDQuest RoboBlast: 3 m pine with collision (scale 1.5-2.2 for big trees), 0.8 m leafy bush, 0.9 m mushroom cluster, orange-yellow flower, white flower patch. Wind-animated foliage.
use_when: 3D platformers, cartoon adventure, kids or cozy prompts that want a painted stylised forest. Pairs well with nature-chunky-trees.
how_to_use: Instance res://starter/nature-stylized-forest/pine_tree.tscn (MeshInstance3D root with StaticBody3D cylinder collider, 3 m tall; scale 1.5-2.2 for hero trees), bush.tscn, mushroom.tscn, orange_flower.tscn, flower_patch.tscn (already scaled 2.2). Pivots at ground, metres. Credit line required (see credit).
credit: Stylised forest art CC-BY 4.0 GDQuest (https://www.gdquest.com/), from the RoboBlast 3D third-person controller demo; shaders MIT GDQuest. Textures downscaled and materials simplified by Summer.
provenance: GDQuest RoboBlast demo via Summer template-3d-third-person-controller (LICENSE: art CC-BY 4.0, code MIT)

verified.notes: demo.tscn rendered in Compatibility and Forward+ with the preview stage; no script/shader errors; fresh-project copy imports and renders. Bark parallax heightmap from the source material dropped for web. v1.1 (2026-10-03, owner rule: building blocks only): demo scene and demo scripts moved out; the remaining pieces are unchanged.
